recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Further edits should wait for a new work-group decision if Vocab wants more detailed $validate-code or cross-system grammar guidance than the modified FHIR-14029 resolution required.
issue_request: FHIR-14029 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification vocab resolution asking for guidance on using post-coordinated expressions with coded data on the Using Codes in FHIR/terminologies page, including a brief explanation and simple examples or links such as SNOMED CT and UCUM.
initial_application: Jira cites GH#9cd28a417c, and git commit 9cd28a417c32ee5852293acef78adb86c3e5e610 added the general coded-value pattern and Complex Code Systems section to source/terminologies.html, including an explanation of code-system grammars, a list of systems with compositional grammars, and a SNOMED CT Coding example.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread confirmed the questions behind the request: post-coordinated expressions can be coded values when allowed by the code system and value set, terminology servers supporting a code-system grammar should understand it for $validate-code, and cross-system composition depends on the grammar. Later related CodeSystem.compositional work for FHIR-17631 and FHIR-28233 was already reconciled separately and does not require duplicating prose on terminologies.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/terminologies.html still explains post-coordination/compositional grammars, lists SNOMED CT and UCUM among examples, and shows a coded instance with a SNOMED CT post-coordinated expression.

related_jiras.note: The same 2017 Zulip discussion identified cleanup from post-composition to compositional/post-coordination wording; that neighboring CodeSystem.compositional issue was already audited separately and does not change this conclusion.
Later CodeSystem.compositional comment guidance points readers to THO code-system pages and Coding.code; it complements but does not supersede the FHIR-14029 terminology-page guidance.
